youtube_short.title: Property Taxes Never Stop — $289K Gone
title_alternatives: Paying Off Your Mortgage Won't Save You From This
The $289K Hidden Cost of 'Owning' Your Home
youtube_short.description: Think paying off your mortgage means you finally own your home? Property taxes don't care — they keep coming every single year, and they grow as your home gains value. Most homeowners pay over $289,000 in property taxes across 40 years of ownership. That's enough to buy a second home just to keep the first one. In retirement, on a fixed income, that rising bill can actually exceed your old mortgage payment. The fix: look up your state's senior exemption, homestead exemption, or property tax freeze — most people never apply. Follow for more hidden financial traps nobody warns you about. #propertytax #personalfinance #homeownership #realestate #moneytips

hook_line: You 'own' your home — but pay forever
